e9564bd docs: describe what happens when a response hits model_max_tokens
Refs #35
3c4f634 fix(conversation): make the summary re-prompt neutral about completion
It no longer claims the work is done or forbids tools: it asks what was
done, what is left and any errors, and lets the model finish first.
Refs #35
8d2f7ea fix(conversation): continue a response cut off by max_tokens instead of asking for a summary
A response that stops with `length` and no tool call ends the agent loop,
but the model did not choose to stop. Send a continuation (tools allowed)
up to 3 cut-offs in a row and within the timeout; post partial text marked
as cut off; past the limit, post an error suggesting a higher
model_max_tokens.
Refs #35
